newsitem.title: USA: Memorex Telex NV to sell Europe unit.
newsitem.headline: Memorex Telex NV to sell Europe unit.

text.p: Memorex Telex NV of the Netherlands on Friday said its chief executive and supervisory board resigned as the company prepared to sell its European operations.
Memorex said it had hired Price Waterhouse to help it sell the operations, which provide computer networks to corporate and governmental organizations.
"No assurance can be given that the proceeds from the sales of the European and remaining operations will repay the secured credit facilities," it said.
Memorex said the proceeds it had received from the sale of its U.S., Canadian, and Mexican operations had not materially reduced amounts owed to the lenders to its secured credit facilities.
It did not say whether its plans to sell its operations in Europe had anything to do with the resignations.
Peter Dailey resigned as chief executive and as a member of the management board of the company, it said.
As of March 31, all the members of its supervisory board had resigned, it added, explaining that it was no longer obligated to have such a board.
